name: techdella/tabs
title: Tabs
description: Accessible ARIA tabs (Paid "platform tabs"): each panel has a job chip, title, text, fact cards or bullets, and an optional mock or image. Without JavaScript every panel shows as a stacked section; JS turns them into tabs (arrow keys, Home, End).
